FACT-1.gloss: Polly throws the javelin 400 feet away

RULE-1.gloss: If a person holds sapphire gemstone and distance to javelin is 400, then distance to javelin is 1200
RULE-1.formula: ∀p((Distance(p, javelin, distance_400) ∧ Holds(p, sapphire_gemstone)) → Distance(p, javelin, distance_1200))

RULE-2.gloss: If distance to javelin is 1200, dragon reach is 1000, and person holds sapphire gemstone, then the person can stand between 1000 and 1200 feet from the dragon
RULE-2.formula: ∀p((Distance(p, javelin, distance_1200) ∧ DragonReach(dragon, distance_1000) ∧ Holds(p, sapphire_gemstone)) → CanStandBetween(p, dragon, distance_1000, distance_1200))

INF-1.gloss: Distance(polly, javelin, distance_1200) from FACT-1 and RULE-1 by Modus Ponens

INF-2.gloss: CanStandBetween(polly, dragon, distance_1000, distance_1200) from INF-1, FACT-2, FACT-3, and RULE-2 by Modus Ponens
